question: nearest river to Egypt excluding lakes
sql: WITH egypt AS (SELECT geometry FROM countries WHERE name = 'Egypt') SELECT r.name, ST_Distance_Sphere(r.geometry, egypt.geometry) AS dist_m FROM rivers r, egypt WHERE r.feature_class = 'River' ORDER BY dist_m LIMIT 1;

question: closest country to Nile river
sql: WITH nile AS (SELECT ST_Union_Agg(geometry) AS geom FROM rivers WHERE name = 'Nile') SELECT c.name, ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, nile.geom) AS dist_m FROM countries c, nile ORDER BY dist_m LIMIT 1;

question: countries within 150km of Amazon river
sql: WITH amazon AS (SELECT ST_Union_Agg(geometry) AS geom FROM rivers WHERE name = 'Amazon') SELECT c.name, ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, amazon.geom) AS dist_m FROM countries c, amazon WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, amazon.geom) <= 150000 ORDER BY dist_m;

question: nearest river for each African country
sql: SELECT c.name AS country, r.name AS nearest_river, ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, r.geometry) AS dist_m FROM countries c CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r2.name, r2.geometry FROM rivers r2 ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, r2.geometry) LIMIT 1) r WHERE c.continent = 'Africa' ORDER BY c.name;

question: distance between USA and Russia in km
sql: WITH usa AS (SELECT ST_Union_Agg(geometry) AS geom FROM countries WHERE iso_a3 = 'USA'), russia AS (SELECT ST_Union_Agg(geometry) AS geom FROM countries WHERE iso_a3 = 'RUS') SELECT ST_Distance_Sphere(usa.geom, russia.geom) / 1000 AS dist_km FROM usa, russia;

question: country closest to centroid of Australia
sql: WITH australia AS (SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS centroid FROM countries WHERE name = 'Australia') SELECT c.name, ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, australia.centroid) AS dist_m FROM countries c, australia WHERE c.name != 'Australia' ORDER BY dist_m LIMIT 1;
